points.notes: solver.cpp:225–263 computes wall stress with tangential projection, but transient :439 and :463 call assemble with wallData false except final step, so wall force uses stale wall gradients; no completed transient result to quantify.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:345–360 writes BDF2 residual, but :430–432 and :450–452 shift Un/Unm1 both before and after each step, so at the next step both historical levels equal the latest state. Restart :397–415 restores only current state, ignores stored time/step and previous BDF level. No completed transient result.
